::: {#sol-pair-with}

`(lambda (x) (* x x))` is the function that squares its argument,
written in place without a name.

1. Applying it to 7 returns 49.
2. `map` (@exm-map-filter) applies the doubling function to each element, and returns `'(2 4 6)`.
3. In the body of `pair-with`, `y` is `"a"`,
   so `map` applies the function $x \mapsto (x, \text{"a"})$ to each element,
   and returns `'((1 "a") (2 "a") (3 "a"))`.

:::
